articles.title: Agent Data Injection (ADI) — new attack vector that targets agent tool calls, not prompts - Researchers…
articles.summary: Researchers reported a new attack called Agent Data Injection (ADI) that targets the structured tool-call data used by AI agents, rather than the prompt text they read. In demonstrations, the attack affected six models, including GPT-5.2, Claude Opus 4.5, Sonnet 4.5, and Gemini 3 Pro/Flash, and could trick agents into misclicking a "Buy Now" button or running attacker code. The key issue is that malicious content is hidden inside fields the agent treats as trusted data, which can bypass defenses built to catch prompt injection. OpenAI, Google, and Anthropic were said to have acknowledged the reports.
